evidence.title: Animated Components for React Native & Expo Apps

name: LiquidSwitch
summary: Liquid-morphing animated toggle switch component for React Native, built with Skia and Reanimated, with optional state icons.
description: Self-contained copy-paste React Native switch: a smooth liquid-style slide between ON and OFF states, optional icons per state, customizable track and thumb colors and responsive size scaling. Props include size, gap, trackColors, thumbColor, images, initialValue and onChange.
contains: single copy-paste LiquidSwitch.tsx component, no setup
liquid slide animation between ON and OFF states
optional image icons for both states with tint support
props: size, gap, trackColors, thumbColor, images, initialValue, onChange
requires React Native Reanimated and Skia
